about_short_description.short_description: Makanak offers office space for rent like coworking space, shared desks, virtual offices and meeting rooms.

product.name: Private Office
product.description: A dedicated office space for individuals or teams, offering privacy and the ability to customize the environment to suit business needs.

product.name: Virtual Office
product.description: A service providing a professional business address, mail handling, and call forwarding without the need for a physical office.

product.name: Meeting Rooms
product.description: Fully-equipped spaces available for rent to host meetings, conferences, or presentations, accommodating various group sizes.

product.name: Training Rooms
product.description: Spaces designed for hosting training sessions or workshops, equipped with necessary amenities and technology.

product.name: Shared Desks
product.description: Flexible workspace options allowing individuals to rent a desk in a shared environment, promoting collaboration and networking.
